name: L14 · 这本书被别人借走了

intro.cn: 在校园餐厅，李文和白家月正在聊天儿。
intro.en: In the campus cafeteria, Li Wen and Bai Jiayue were chatting.

questions.q: 白家月下午要帮李文做什么？
白家月是怎么知道《名人的故事》这本书的？

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.cn: 我借的这本词典最好今天还，但是我没时间去。
lines.en: The dictionary I borrowed is due today, but I don't have time to return it.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 下午我只有两节课，可以帮你去图书馆还书。
lines.en: I only have two classes this afternoon, so I can help you return it to the library.

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.cn: 那太谢谢了。你能再帮我借本书吗？
lines.en: Thank you so much! Could you also help me borrow another book?

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 行，你告诉我书名。
lines.en: Sure, just tell me the title.

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.cn: 我把名字写在纸上吧。我去了好几次图书馆，这本书都被别人借走了。
lines.en: I'll write it down for you. I've been to the library several times, but this book is always checked out.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 《名人的故事》？我有这本书。明天我借给你吧。
lines.en: Stories of Celebrities? I have that book—I'll lend it to you tomorrow.

postQuestions.q: 李文请白家月帮他借什么书？
李文为什么没借到这本书？
李文把书名写在哪儿了？

intro.cn: 在校园里，白家月和安妮在聊天儿。
intro.en: On campus, Bai Jiayue and Annie were chatting.

questions.q: 下课以后白家月要做什么？
安妮觉得进不去图书馆可以怎么做？

lines.speaker: 安妮
lines.cn: 今天下课早，你一会儿做什么？
lines.en: Classes ended early today. What are your plans for later?

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 我今天忙得很，要先去图书馆借书，然后去游泳。
lines.en: I'm really busy today. First, I need to go to the library to borrow some books, and then I'm going swimming.

lines.speaker: 安妮
lines.cn: 咱们一起走吧，我想去图书馆看看中文报纸。
lines.en: Let's go together. I want to check out some Chinese newspapers at the library.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 等等，我的校园卡不见了，没有卡进不去图书馆。
lines.en: Wait a minute—my campus card is missing. I won't be able to enter the library without it.

lines.speaker: 安妮
lines.cn: 你想想上一次用是什么时候？
lines.en: Do you remember when you last used it?

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 我忘记了，可能被我放在家里了。
lines.en: I don't remember. Maybe I left it at home.

lines.speaker: 安妮
lines.cn: 进不去图书馆也没关系，上网看看有没有电子书。
lines.en: It's okay if you can't get into the library. You can look for e-books online instead.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 不行，我必须去，我还得帮李文还书呢。
lines.en: No, I have to go. I have to return Li Wen's book.

postQuestions.q: 下课以后安妮要做什么？
白家月为什么不能进图书馆？
白家月觉得校园卡可能在哪儿？

intro.cn: 在校园餐厅，李文和白家月边吃边聊。
intro.en: In the campus cafeteria, Li Wen and Bai Jiayue were chatting while eating.

questions.q: 李文和白家月在说什么？

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.cn: 下周学校有晚会，你知道吗？
lines.en: There's a school party next week. Have you heard about it?

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 知道，我和几个女生要表演一个节目。你也参加吗？
lines.en: Yes, a few other girls and I are going to perform. Are you joining too?

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.cn: 我想唱中文歌，但是还没找到人一起表演，不知道怎么办。
lines.en: I want to sing a Chinese song, but I haven't found anyone to perform with yet. I'm not sure what to do.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 找不到人，你就一个人唱吧。
lines.en: If you can't find anyone, just perform solo.

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.cn: 一想到要在校长、老师和那么多同学面前表演，我就有些紧张。
lines.en: Just thinking about performing in front of the principal, teachers, and so many classmates makes me a bit nervous.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 紧张什么啊，我们都喜欢听你唱歌，你要相信自己。
lines.en: What's there to be nervous about? We all love hearing you sing. You just need to believe in yourself.

postQuestions.q: 白家月要在晚上做什么？
听说李文有点儿紧张，白家月是怎么说的？

intro.cn: 在家里，白家月在写日记。
intro.en: At home, Bai Jiayue was writing in her diary.

questions.q: 昨天的晚会谁表演节目了？

lines.cn: 昨天是我们学校的新年晚会，每个班级的同学都表演节目了。
lines.en: Yesterday was our school's New Year's party, and students from every class put on performances.

lines.cn: 晚会是八点开始的，差不多十二点才结束。
lines.en: The party started at 8 p.m. and didn't end until nearly midnight.

lines.cn: 我一个晚上跟大家又唱又跳，开心极了，也累坏了。
lines.en: I spent the whole evening singing and dancing with everyone—it was so much fun, but I was completely worn out.

lines.cn: 我最喜欢的节目是留学生们跳舞，最后老师和校长也被叫起来一块儿跳，特别有意思。
lines.en: My favorite act was the dance by the international students. Toward the end, even the teachers and the principal were invited to join the dance floor, which made it especially entertaining.

lines.cn: 过几天学校的网站上会有晚会的视频，我打算再看一遍。
lines.en: In a few days, the videos will be uploaded to the school's website, and I'm planning to watch them again.

postQuestions.q: 晚会是什么时候开始的？什么时候结束的？
白家月最喜欢哪个节目？为什么？
过几天白家月打算做什么？

grammar.note: 汉语中用带“被”字的句子表达被动意义，突出主语受到了某个动作的影响，语气常带有被动、无奈、负面等色彩。副词和能愿动词放在“被”字前面，“被”字后面的宾语可以省略。基本结构：主语+被+宾语+动词+其他成分。
grammar.noteEn: In Chinese, sentences with “被” express the passive voice, emphasizing that the subject is affected by an action. These sentences often convey a sense of passivity, helplessness, or negativity. Adverbs and modal verbs are placed before “被”, and the object following “被” can be omitted. Basic structure: Subject+被+Object+Verb+Other Elements.

items.en: This book was borrowed by someone else.
The fruit may have been eaten by my younger brother.

items.c: 我们俩经常被叫错名字。
items.en: The two of us are often called by the wrong names.

grammar.note: 承接复句“先……，再/然后……”中，两个分句表示动作的先后顺序。
grammar.noteEn: In a successive complex sentence “先……，再/然后……”, the clauses indicate the chronological order of actions.

items.c: 我要先去图书馆借书，然后去游泳。
items.en: First, I need to go to the library to borrow some books, and then I'm going swimming.

items.c: 你先去买门票，再来这里找我。
items.en: First go buy the tickets, then come back here to find me.

items.c: 你们先回房间休息一会儿，然后再出来吃晚饭。
items.en: First go back to your rooms and rest for a while, then come out for dinner.

practice.cn: A：考完试了，你有什么打算？
A：听说你妈妈要来北京，你打算带她去哪儿玩？

grammar.note: 固定格式“×什么（啊）”通常用于否定对方的担忧、疑问或强调事实，带有反驳或安慰的语气。
grammar.noteEn: The fixed pattern “×什么（啊）” is often used to dismiss someone's concerns or doubts, or to emphasize a fact. It carries a tone of refutation or reassurance.

items.c: 紧张什么啊，我们都喜欢听你唱歌，你要相信自己。
items.en: What's there to be nervous about? We all love hearing you sing. You just need to believe in yourself.

items.c: 胖什么啊，你看起来不胖也不瘦。
items.en: What's there to be fat about? You don't look fat or thin.
What's the rush? We'll be there soon.

classroomActivity.description: 两人一组，讲述“最倒霉的一天”。尽量使用被动句来描述所发生的事情，看看谁说的被动句最多。
classroomActivity.descriptionEn: Work in pairs to talk about “the unluckiest day”. Use as many passive sentences as possible to describe what happened. See who can produce the most passive sentences.
